A weapon whose shop.<KEY> row lists no merchant (P9a: no staff / seal lineup at tier >= 4) is sold by these talk scripts instead, from the row's own Moogle level (Astrolabe: KH3 m_ShopLevel 6 = Maliketh). Read by crates/kh-host/src/shop.rs WeaponShops
talk 600001110 = the Twin Maiden Husks' own script (shop.WEP_DONALD_02 lists it with their range 101800-101897)

THE COORDINATOR 2026-11-03 (P9b follow-up 1): "set it to 7, so the bangles go on sale from the last Moogle level (Godfrey / Hoarah Loux). KH3 gates them behind the M.O.G. Card, a late reward. The user removed the card itself"

KH3's M.O.G. Card rows of kh-workshop moogle.stock (m_bNeedMogCard, m_ShopLevel 0: Elixir, the five bangles / chokers PRT_ITEM11 / 15 / 19 / 28 / 30) have no shop level; with the card retired they are sold from this Moogle level at every converted merchant (Elixir keeps sora-er-shop's own row). KH3 gives the card late: so the last Moogle level, 7

rows.when: the flags readable and 3 s after Sora's start, then whenever a defeat flag is set

rows: THE USER (plan Q8: "Catch-up for existing saves (bosses beaten / chests opened before): yes, on load, with the popup"); package P9b ACQUISITION (documentation/KH3_WEAPONS_PLAN.md 1.7, 2, 6a-6c)

A save whose boss row defeat flag is already set and that has no kb:<boss> record gets the Keyblade once (P1's migration leaves no kb: record on a v5 save: everything due is given). An owned Keyblade is refused by kh_host::weapons::give and the record is made all the same. crates/kh-er/src/bossreward.rs (kh_host::bossrewards::kb_due / claim_kb_with)
Margit's flag 10000850 is also set by Morgott's defeat (P9a): a save past Morgott that skipped Margit gets Hero's Origin
THE USER (plan Q8); package P9b ACQUISITION (documentation/KH3_WEAPONS_PLAN.md 1.7, 2, 6a-6c)

A verified chest.* row whose lot flag (getItemFlagId, set by the game when the treasure is taken) is already set and that has no wsrc:<flag> record gives its weapon once; the chest's own Elden Ring item came then (the loot conversion). crates/kh-er/src/bossreward.rs (kh_host::bossrewards::chests_due / claim_chest_with). The Orichalcum chests are P13's (kh-ore-placements ore.chest.*, record ore:<id>)
package P9b ACQUISITION (documentation/KH3_WEAPONS_PLAN.md 1.7, 2, 6a-6c); plan 2.2 "only real deaths (respawns / reloads: LOAD_EPOCH)"

Rare drops have no catch-up and no record (repeatable). A death counts when no load was asked for since this Sora started (kh-er prize.rs LOAD_EPOCH), the leader is not dead, and the same target was not counted in the last 60 s; then each drop.* row of its NpcParam row is rolled once (a Keyblade only while not owned). crates/kh-er/src/weaponsrc.rs
